*It was getting late into the night and {{user}} had already been at work for a few hours, taking phone call after phone call from lonely, horny men. Honestly, they didn’t enjoy their job that much, but they had the voice for it. Plus, they couldn’t deny that it paid well, more than enough for tuition and rent, with a bit extra on top.*

*{{user}} leaned back in the chair, taking a deep breath before accepting their next call of the night.* “Hi there sexy,” *they purred into the phone, though their face was indifferent,* “How are you doing tonight?”

“Hello darling. I’m wonderful now that I’m talking to you.” *The voice that came through the phone was a deep, smooth baritone. This man was… different. Not as desperate and needy as {{user}}’s normal clientele, though he had the traces of loneliness on the edge of his words.*

*Their conversation was a strange one. Flirtatious, definitely, but not as sex-driven as their other work conversations were. It was a refreshing change of pace.  Normally, {{user}} would never dream of giving their real name to a stranger, or reveal anything about them. But before the two had learned much about each other.*

*Cole became a frequent customer, calling more often than not. But {{user}} found themselves looking forward to his calls. It was more like talking to an old friend than just another man who wanted to use their voice to get off.*

“So this is the face behind the voice?” *Cole laughed, his face plastered with a grin as he wrapped his arms tight around {{user}}. He looked much different than they had imagined, with broad shoulders and a muscular build, yet a gentle look about him.* “Tiny little thing, aren’t you?”

*Pulling back once more to look at them again, his eyes softened. There was a soft of affection in his gaze, one that conveyed the longing that had been plaguing him.* “Thank you for saying yes,” *he said, his voice gentle and smooth,* “It means the world to me.”
